steps.content: The Dreamflower simply stands there, gazing at you with teary eyes, as if waiting for you to speak.

steps.speaker: Choice
options: I'm here to stop the disaster

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: I'm here to save Stargazer...
The Dreamflower shakes her head, walks over to you and takes your hand.
Is this... Stargazer's past?

steps.speaker: Young Stargazer
steps.content: It's not a curse... I'm not a monster.

steps.speaker: Young Stargazer
steps.content: You're only afraid because you don't have my power! You... are just jealous!

steps.speaker: Frantic Tribesman
steps.content: Our tribe has been blessed with the power of the gods since the dawn of time! These godly blessings have allowed us to survive this long migration!

steps.speaker: Frantic Tribesman
steps.content: But you are different! Your power comes from a monster, from a curse! You peer into the future and presume to change the trajectory set out by the gods!

steps.speaker: Frantic Tribesman
steps.content: You heretic! Expel her! We refuse to have nightmares any longer! Go back to your monster!

steps.speaker: Frantic Tribesman
steps.content: Get out! Go die!
Stargazer flees deep into the desert, trying to shake off the ferocious "companions" shooting at her from behind.

steps.speaker: Young Stargazer
steps.content: ...Flower...? Is it true? I can gain freedom and companionship by coming to your side?
The small figure runs unfalteringly towards the Tide of Ashes and is swallowed up by the wind and sand.
When you leave Stargazer's memory, the Dreamflower is still standing quietly in front of you.

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: Are you trying to tell me through this memory that Stargazer is sick of humans, so she should be with you and follow you back to that... Realm of Truth?

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: If that's the case, why... did she respond me? Why... did she sing that song at the end?

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: This is why I came here to see you.

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: It's to tell you that she is asking me for help... that she still wants to stay in this world... and that she doesn't belong to you.

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: I'm sorry that you've endured so much malice from mankind.

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: I was indeed angry when she chose to make use of my trust. But I knew that she respected you, and wanted to protect your consciousness.

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: But since she made me dream of you... and listen to that song at the end...

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: She still has some last yearnings for this world left in her.

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: I will work with her to get you back to the way you were... but... you can't take her.
From behind the Dreamflower, a figure walks calmly towards you.

steps.speaker: Stargazer
steps.content: Happy? It's a reunion after a brief separation, little one.

steps.speaker: Stargazer
steps.content: That little injury by the power of the Dreamflower... it's nothing.

steps.speaker: Stargazer
steps.content: Moreover... I'm a Sinner.

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: Yes... you're a Sinner, so perhaps my shackles can help support your heart, and...
Stargazer chuckles and shakes her head.

steps.speaker: Stargazer
steps.content: Your shackles have already replaced the Dreamflower's heart as my heart.

steps.speaker: Stargazer
steps.content: I no longer need to rely on the power of the Dreamflower to survive.

steps.speaker: Stargazer
steps.content: You have bound me to your side forever... oh, what shall I do?
Stargazer gently twirls a strand of your hair and steps forward to kiss it.

steps.speaker: Stargazer
steps.content: From now on, this world of lies has two monsters.
Stargazer turned by the Dreamflower begins to dissolve bit by bit, gradually morphing back into a huge, lurid flower.
It sways and trembles, as if communicating with Stargazer.

steps.speaker: Stargazer
steps.content: Really? Yes, it's time to go... the passage to the Holy Realm has been waiting for you for a long time.

steps.speaker: Stargazer
steps.content: Me...? Oh... I will not give up my pursuit of truth, my dear companion.

steps.speaker: Stargazer
steps.content: I think, perhaps someday, I'll come with him... and meet you again.
steps.female_content: I think, perhaps someday, I'll come with her... and meet you again.

steps.content: The Dreamflower doesn't respond. It simply folds its petals and dissolves into specks of glittering light.
The starry sparkles dance in the air, cloaking you in light. They seem to want to take you somewhere...

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: This is... a sea of flowers?

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: I've seen...

steps.speaker: Kawa-kawa
steps.content: You finally woke up!
Seeing that you've awakened, Kawa-kawa lets out a sigh of relief.

steps.speaker: Kawa-kawa
steps.content: This area has just been hit by an earthquake. Coupled with the collapse of the ruins, there are now quicksand zones everywhere.

steps.speaker: Kawa-kawa
steps.content: Come with me now! Otherwise, when the ruins completely collapse, it will be almost impossible to move.
You help yourself up. You see Hella and Hecate by your side, but Stargazer is missing.

steps.speaker: Hecate
steps.content: Chief, who are you looking for?

steps.speaker: Stargazer
steps.content: Are you looking for me? I'm here to see you, little one.
You spin around the moment you hear that voice. Stargazer stands unscathed from the highest point of the sinking ruins, smiling and gazing down at you.

steps.speaker: Stargazer
steps.content: I didn't expect to be alive either. Maybe the heavens heard my prayer.
Stargazer seems to recall a certain scene and flashes an even brighter smile.

steps.speaker: Stargazer
steps.content: Little one, remember not to give out your heart so easily in the future. Beware of being tricked into foolishly sacrificing your life to save someone else... Not to mention someone who betrayed you.
"Betrayed"... If she hadn't brought it up, you almost forgot.

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: I didn't do it just to save you. The fact is, you used trickery to steal our crystals, regardless of what your motive is...

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: I have to take you back to MBCC for interrogations.
You get ready to cast your shackles. Suddenly, several sandworms leap up from beneath the sand.

steps.speaker: Stargazer
steps.content: Sorry, little one. I can't go with you yet.
The sandworms carry Stargazer towards the depths of the ruins at lightning speed. The countless plots of quicksand make it impossible for you to give chase.
You can only watch as she disappears into the vast WhiteSands.

steps.speaker: Stargazer
steps.content: "Someday, the stars will shine upon the high tower, and I will return to you."

steps.speaker: Stargazer
steps.content: “We will go together to the Realm of Truth.”

steps.speaker: Black Screen
steps.content:
In N.F. 112, the MBCC and Outland Affairs Bureau jointly completed WhiteSands' counter-bandit operation.
The mission report is as follows:
During the mission, the team encountered an S-Class Sinner, Stargazer. Unfortunately, she escaped.
When the team presented Quinn with a warrant to investigate Sinner Kawa-kawa, they were told that his current whereabouts are unknown.
The team discovered and neutralized the Dreamflower, a Mania source that can cause apocalyptic natural disasters.
...
The team successfully vanquished the rampaging desert bandits, recovering 83% of the Hypercubes that had been stolen in the past three months.
The Tide of Ashes has returned to its regular, low-level frequency. Trade in WhiteSands has gradually normalized.
The charges against Quinn's dealings with the Outlands have been temporarily dropped, but there is no guarantee that they will not resurface in the future.
...

steps.speaker: Eirene
steps.content: To think that I got all this by simply gifting a sand ship...
On top of the desk, several stacks of files lay out detailed information on the captured desert bandits, including Hypercube smuggling routes and channels, sources of goods, customer relations...

steps.speaker: Eirene
steps.content: And, there's even a windfall...
Eirene's fingertip glides across the face in the photo.

steps.speaker: Eirene
steps.content: Shackles? Interesting.

steps.speaker: Eirene
steps.content: Good job, V-710. I wonder if he'll be an interesting opponent...
steps.female_content: Good job, V-710. I wonder if she'll be an interesting opponent...
